content: Obuhaka elugulu w'enkembuulo
Mw'ezoola siku, bantu baguma bachimira eAntiyokiya gurhengera eYudeeya. Barhondera kuyigiriza abemeezi ntya: «Akaba murhakembwirwe gukulikirana n'emigenzo ya Muusa, murhagachungulwa.»

Paawulo na Baranaaba babalahirira, banajira obuhaka bunene haguma nabo elugulu w'oguula mwazi. Abemeezi baahiga oku Paawulo na Baranaaba haguma n'abandi baguma omu bo bazamukire eYerusaleema kuganiira kw'echo chibazo embere z'eNtumwa n'abashamuka b'echigusho ch'abemeezi.

Echigusho ch'abemeezi chabaheereza ebintu byooshi by'olugenzi balilagire ko. Baagera omu gihugo ch'eFoyinikiya na ech'eSamariya, baliiri baabala gurhe abarhali Bayaahudi bayemereere kuba bemeezi. Ogu mwazi gwaliiri gwasimiisa bweneene abemeezi booshi.
Bahikire eYerusaleema, bayankirirwa n'eNtumwa, n'echigusho ch'abemeezi haguma n'abashamuka baacho. Babala byooshi Nnamahanga ajirire kugerera bo.
Aliko, bantu baguma b'omu chigusho ch'aBafarisaayo bahindukaga bemeezi, bayimanga n'okuderha ntya: «Bihemere gukembuula abarhali Bayaahudi n'okubarhegeka ogukenga eRhegeko lya Muusa.»
Enaama y'okumala obuhaka b'ogukembuulwa
Entumwa n'abashamuka b'echigusho ch'abemeezi bajira enaama elugulu w'echo chibazo.

Enyuma z'obuhaka bunene, Petero ayimanga n'okubabwira ntya: «Beene beerhu, muyinji bwinja oku gurhengera miira Nnamahanga andondwere ahagarhi kenyu yi kugerera obuunu bwani, abarhali Bayaahudi bayunve oMwazi Mwinja, banayemeere Yeesu.
Na Nnamahanga oyinji emirhima y'abantu, aliyerekeene oku ayemereere abarhali Bayaahudi nabo omu guha bo Muuka-Mutagatiifu kuguma neerhu.
Nta kalondoole ajirire ahagarhi keerhu nabo, bulaala acheeseze emirhima yaabo kugerera obwemeezi.
Chagarhuma bunoola mwageregeza Nnamahanga omu guheesa abemeezi ogu muzigo, abe bashookuluza beerhu, abe neerhu rhwenyine rhurhagalaga guheeka?
Maani neerhu, rhuyinji oku rhwachungwirwe elugulu w'olukogo lwa Nnaweerhu Yeesu, nk'oku nabo bachungwirwe.»
Abantu booshi balichigushire baasira. Bayunviriza oku Paawulo na Baranaaba baabala emyaazi elugulu w'ebimenyeeso n'ebigiriginjo byooshi Nnamahanga ajirire kugerera bo ahagarhi k'abarhali Bayaahudi.
Babeere baasira, Yakobo naye aderha ntya: «Beene beerhu, munyunvirize!
Simooni Petero arhubaliire gurhe Nnamahanga achiyerekeene oku barhali Bayaahudi oku burhanzi y'achishoga baguma omu bo babe bantu baage.
Eyi myaazi eri kuguma n'ebinwa by'abaleebi nk'okubiyandikirwe ntya:

content.text: n'ogushuba kuyumbaka enju ya Daawudi yashandeere.
neechi, abantu b'embaga zooshi nahamageere babe baani.
Ntyo ku Nnaweerhu aderhere, yi wajiraga ebyo bintu

content: Cho girhumire, nyoono, mbwene oku rhurhalibuzaga abarhali Bayaahudi bali bayemeera Nnamahanga.
Aliko, rhubayandikire oku barhalyaaga ebiryo byarhuulirwaga emaana, banachilange n'obuhushi. Barhanalemaga baalya enyama zakanulwaga changwa omulegano.
Bulaala gurhengera miira, eRhegeko lya Muusa linayigirizwa omu ngasi gishagala, linasomwa omu masinagoogi m'aBayaahudi ngasi lusiku lw'eSaabato.»
Amaruba oku bemeezi barhali Bayaahudi

Enyuma z'aho, eNtumwa, abashamuka n'echigusho chooshi ch'abemeezi ch'eYerusaleema, babona oku bakwaneene bachishoge ahagarhi kaabo bantu baguma, banabarhume eAntiyokiya haguma na Paawulo na Baranaaba. Baava bagishoga Yuuda oyirikwa kandi Barisaba na Siila. Abo bantu oku bali babiri balikengerwe bweneene embere z'abaabo bemeezi.

Babarhuma n'amaruba maliyandikirwe mo ntya: «Rhwabo, eNtumwa n'abashamuka b'echigusho ch'abemeezi, rhwabo benyu bemeezi, rhwabalamwise mwabo bemeezi murhali Bayaahudi muli omu gishagala ch'eAntiyokiya, n'omu gihugo ch'eSuriya na ech'eKilikiya.
Rhwayunviirhe oku bantu baguma barhengeraga eno mwerhu, bababwirire emyaazi y'okubalibuza n'okubahahaaza emirhima. Aliko rhurhabarhumaga.
Boboola, oku rhuli rhweshi haguma, rhwayunvikeene gugishoga bantu baguma, rhwamabarhuma emwenyu, bayinje haguma n'abazigirwa beerhu Baranaaba na Paawulo.
Abo bombi, bayemereere guhaana akalamo kaabo omu gukolera Nnaweerhu Yeesu Krisitu.
Ntyo ku rhwamabarhumira Yuuda na Siila. Nabo, bababwira buunu oku bwindi ebinwa rhubayandikiire.
Kandi, kuli kwinja emwa Muuka-Mutagatiifu n'emwerhu ogurhabahekesa ogwindi muzigo kuleka ebiri by'akamaro:
murhalyaaga enyama barhuuliraga emaana n'omulegano changwa enyama zakanulwaga, munachilange n'obuhushi. Mugachilanga kw'ebi, mwaba mwajirire bwinja. Buchaage!»
Bamalire guseezerana, abo barhumagwa bagenda n'okuyandagalira eAntiyokiya. Bagerere eyo, bagusha abemeezi booshi, banabahereza amo maruba.
Nabo, babeere bamamasoma, basiima elugulu w'ebinwa by'okubaseeza omurhima byabaaga biyandikirwe mo.
Gukulikirana n'oku Yuuda na Siila baliiri baleebi, babwira abaabo bemeezi binwa binene by'okubaseeza omurhima n'okubakomeza.
Babeere bamamala yo siku, abemeezi babaseezera, banababwira bagaluke n'obuholo yi bashigaane ababarhumaga.
[Aliko Siila yeewe abona bwinja ayoorhe eyo munda.]
Paawulo na Baranaaba nabo bayoorha eyo Antiyokiya. Boowe haguma n'abandi bantu banene, baalema bayigiriza n'okuyamagaza oMwazi Mwinja guyerekeere Nnaweerhu.
Paawulo na Baranaaba balekana
Enyuma w'esiku zigeeke, Paawulo abwira Baranaaba ntya: «Rhugaluke rhuje kulola beene beerhu bemeezi omu bishagala byooshi rhwayigirizaga m'oMwazi gwa Nnaweerhu, rhumenye gurhe yi baalama.»
Baranaaba alishondere Yohaana oyirikwa Mariko agende haguma nabo.
Aliko Paawulo abona oku birhakwiriire, kwenge Mariko abaaga abalekere omu gihugo ch'ePamfiliya, analilahiire kugendekeza gukola haguma nabo.
Haja haahulukira obuhaka bunene bwarhuma balekana. Baranaaba agenda aherekezwe na Mariko, baja omu chombo, bayambukira oku chizimba ch'eGipuro.
Paawulo achishoga Siila. Abemeezi bamalire kumuhemera olukogo lwa Nnaweerhu, agenda.
Agerera omu gihugo ch'eSuriya n'eche Kilikiya ey'ali akomeza ebigusho by'abemeezi.
